verdict.rationale: An API reference page exists for the Sonar endpoint, with a documented request/response schema (docs-23), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published (probe-3). The docs also point to an interactive Playground where you can try Perplexity Search with no API key required (docs-14), so runnable exploration exists, but nothing shows the reference pages themselves have embedded try-it or runnable examples. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable code samples per endpoint, Playground coverage beyond Search, and independent hands-on corroboration.
